cues.en: Now that we are done with the setup related to machine learning, we shall now create custom tasks for machine learning model training.

cues.en: These tasks shall also help us in managing our resource intensive machine learning tasks by handling these long running processes outside the web request cycle asynchronously using celery.
cues.zh: 也能管理耗用大量資源的機器學習工作，透過 Celery 非同步處理耗時程序，讓它們離開網頁請求的處理週期。

cues.en: This is going to help us to improve the performance of our application.
